status: first_baseline_code_ready_for_review; CPU checks and one frozen VAE window verified; full DiT GPU execution not yet verified

condition.history: RGB frames at or before the prediction anchor; never future frames
condition.current_observation: full-scene RGB when required by the history-conditioned architecture

target.content: object RGB on source black background
target.supervision: First baseline: future obj-video supervision plus RGB condition-prefix auxiliary reconstruction with the upstream prefix loss weight 1.0. Export only future obj predictions.

dataset_split.status: current_prompts_and_embeddings_ready; paired training loader connected; frozen partition preserved
dataset_split.evaluation_scope: Held-out episodes of the same 50 tasks.
dataset_split.training_rule: Use manifests.train for optimization and fitted dataset statistics; keep manifests.test held out. All frames/windows/cameras of an episode inherit its split. Do not train from the unsplit all/without_unresolved_prompt_flags manifests.
dataset_split.dedup_rule: Each train/test row supplies dedup_index_path and its SHA256; sample in deduplicated_frame_order, then decode the shared source_frame_indices from the original RGB and object MP4s.

training_window.upstream_condition_history_frames_note: The upstream field includes the current frame: seven past frames plus current. The episode first frame is added separately.
training_window.boundary_policy: Clamp negative history positions to episode frame 0 and mark them as padding; episode-first/current remain valid. Training anchors require s+80<N, so all 16 future frames are real and no future padding is used.
training_window.note: Implemented window: I_0 plus I_[s-210:s:30] (including I_s), followed by O_[s+5:s+80:5]. Map all sampled deduplicated positions through the same source_frame_indices before decoding RGB/obj. Seven past frames plus current span 210 retained-frame intervals; this is not exactly seven simulation seconds.

first_baseline.training_sequence: 9 full-scene RGB condition-prefix frames followed by 16 object-only future frames
first_baseline.loss_normalization: Retain the upstream weighted mean over valid prefix and future latent positions, with the existing padding mask.
first_baseline.inference_prefix_policy: Retain upstream joint denoising of all seven latent positions; do not add prefix clamping in this baseline.

implementation_checks_required: Load the frozen train/test split manifests and preserve episode isolation when sampling windows.
Read RGB conditions and obj targets from separate paired paths.
Do not default to target obj first frame as the RGB condition.
Match history/current-observation latent placement at training and inference.
Keep condition_latent_loss_weight=1.0 for the first baseline; log RGB-prefix and obj-future losses separately without changing the upstream total-loss normalization.
Retain upstream denoising in the first baseline; decode the full 25-frame sequence and export only frames [9:25] as obj predictions.
Ensure VAE temporal indexing and padding masks align with the future obj segment; use a tiny train/infer batch before full training.

text_embeddings.encoding: Frozen pretrained UMT5 encoder, eval/inference mode; real padding mask preserved.
